user.title: Where to listen and what to consult
user.description: Everything here is optional except at least one microphone on the next page.

data_description.frigate_url: Used to list cameras and reach their audio. For the Frigate add-on this is usually port 5000 on the host ccab4aaf-frigate-fa.
data_description.birdnet_url: For bird species. For the BirdNET-Go add-on this is usually port 8080 on the host db21ed7f-birdnet-go.
data_description.adsb_url: Only for 'My own receiver': a tar1090 aircraft.json address, or a readsb-style address with lat, lon and nm placeholders, each in curly braces.
data_description.dispatch: Consulted only after a siren has been heard. Twelve agencies are built in.
data_description.units: Automatic follows Home Assistant's unit system: miles and feet for US customary, kilometres and metres otherwise.

data.stream_overrides: Other microphones, or addresses that differ
data.ignore: Kinds of sound to leave out
data.clips: Keep a short recording of each sound
data.min_confidence: Report a sound only when at least this sure
data.video: Let camera sightings support a sound

data_description.stream_template: The words host and camera in curly braces are replaced with Frigate's host and each camera's restream name. Leave as it is unless your restreams are named differently.
data_description.stream_overrides: One per line: name=address. Anything ffmpeg can open.
data_description.cameras: Each one costs an ffmpeg process decoding audio only
data_description.clips: Up to 30 seconds from the microphone that heard it best, for the last 100 sounds, so the card can play it back. Kept in temporary storage only: never in a backup, and cleared when Home Assistant restarts.
data_description.min_confidence: 50 % reports everything the integration believes more likely than not. Raise it to drop the doubtful ones, at the cost of missing some real ones. Applies to the card and to the sensors.
data_description.video: Off by default: every sound is identified from audio alone. On, a vehicle or a dog that Frigate sees on a camera counts as supporting evidence for a sound heard at the same time.

geometry.title: Where each microphone is
geometry.description: Seen from the middle of the house: the compass bearing to each microphone (0 = north, 90 = east) and how far away it is. Rough figures are enough; they only steer the direction estimate.

error.cannot_connect: Frigate did not answer at that address
error.no_mics: Choose at least one camera or add one microphone line
error.adsb_url: Give the address of your receiver
